description: Check any AI agent's EU AI Act Article-50 transparency posture — including agents Hlido has NOT reviewed yet. Returns two clearly separated layers: (1) Hlido's independent register verdict when the agent is in our reviewed corpus, and (2) a live public-surface probe of the Article-50 signals (AI-interaction disclosure, machine-readable marking/provenance, deepfake/synthetic labelling, detection tool). Use before adopting or delegating to a tool ahead of the 2026-08-02 transparency obligations. The live probe is a first-pass surface read, NOT a compliance determination and NOT legal advice; an undetected signal means 'not discoverable on the public surface', not 'non-compliant'. Unreviewed agents are automatically queued for a full independent review.

url.description: The agent's product or homepage URL (e.g. 'https://example.com'), or its Hlido slug.

name: verify_transparency
